falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 4200 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2020 Dec breakout pattern typically featured sustained momentum without immediate retracement to prior resistance; a close above 4200 would indicate the breakout is validating rather than failing, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal which implies waiting for confirmation of weakness

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 18 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 18 would signal risk-on normalization and contradict the blowoff score of 50, which implies elevated volatility/uncertainty; this would invalidate the pattern match as the 2020 Dec breakout occurred with VIX already declining into a stable regime

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% and holds there for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid driving yields below 3.50% would indicate macro stress inconsistent with a clean breakout pattern; the 2020 Dec breakout featured rising yields reflecting growth optimism, so this divergence would falsify the pattern match and suggest the 'HOLD' should have been a defensive repositioning

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
